info.title: Sail Scoring public API
info.description: Two parts. The workspace calls act in a workspace for a signed-in user, through an OAuth access token their app obtained with the authorization code flow (PKCE): read its series, set up races, starts and courses, submit a race's finishes for review, and publish; the CLI signs in with the device authorization grant (RFC 8628) at /api/auth/device/code. The published results need no sign-in: results as their published pages show them, each resource following the page that shows it; find publications from /p/index.json and each workspace's index.json. Within v1 changes are additive; a breaking change is a new version, and the old one serves for a year after it.

put.summary: Submit a race's finishes, or revise a submission
put.description: Held beside the race until a scorer applies it to the finish sheet or dismisses it; never written to the sheet directly. Each upload carries the whole recording at a higher `revision`, so an app recording offline uploads its latest whenever it's in range. The same revision sent again is a retry, and changes nothing. A sail number that matches no entry is not an error: `unknownSailNumbers` lists it, and the scorer resolves it. Needs the workspace's finish sheet submissions switched on.

parameters.description: The race.

alternativeSailNumbers.description: Other sail numbers the boat is known by.

names.description: The primary person or people, as the series heads them (helm, owner, skipper).

excluded.description: Entered, but not scored as an entrant.

Score.description: One race score in a standings row.

points.description: Null in an archive, which holds what was printed.

code.description: A result or penalty code (`DNF`, `SCP`, `RDG`), or null.

excluded.description: The race is not in the standings: nobody finished it, or it is not scored yet.

display.description: The cell as the page prints it, e.g. `(12.0 DNF)`.

StandingsRow.description: One competitor's line in a standings table.

fleet.description: A championship row's fleet, where the championship has split.

scores.description: One per column of `races`, in the same order; null where the competitor has no score.

summary.description: An archive's totals columns, as originally published.

subSeries.description: The sub-series the table scores, or null for the whole series.

namesLabel.description: What the competitors' `names` are headed, e.g. `Helm`.

race.description: The race's number in the series, the `n` of `races/{n}`. Null where a column is not one race.

label.description: The column heading, e.g. `R3`. A fleet that sat races out numbers its own.

position.description: Finishing order among the finishers; null for a boat that didn't finish.

resultCode.description: An RRS code (`DNF`, `OCS`, …) for a boat that didn't finish normally.

reviewedRevision.description: The revision that review was of.

matched.description: Rows naming a boat entered in the race.

unknownSailNumbers.description: Sail numbers that match no entry; the scorer resolves them.

skipped.description: Rows the scorer's review will leave out, and why: a boat in no fleet racing in this race, a boat twice.

reviewUrl.description: The race in Sail Scoring, where a scorer reviews it.

api.description: The publication in the published results API, where it has one.

publishedAt.description: An instant, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC (`…Z`).

CreateRaces.description: Races to add after the series' last race, each with its starts. The server numbers them.

id.description: Choose the id, so a retried call can't add the race twice, and the race can be read back by it. An id that is already a race's is refused.

AddStart.description: A start to add to a race that has been created. A fleet starts once per race.

id.description: Choose the id, so the app knows the start without reading the race back.

StartChange.description: The parts of a start to change; a field left out keeps its value, and `null` clears it.

season.description: The season to publish under; defaults to the series' year.

slug.description: Honoured on the first publish only.

fleets.description: The fleets to publish, by name; all of them when left out.

SubmitFinishes.description: The whole recording of a race's finishes, at one revision: each upload replaces the last. Row order is crossing order.

revision.description: Higher than the last upload of this submission: each upload replaces the whole recording.

recordedBy.description: A label for the device or the person, such as `Committee boat`.

starts.description: Start times taken on the water.

startTime.description: The start time taken on the water.

id.description: The row's own id, unique within the submission.

competitorId.description: The boat, where the recorder knew the entry.

sailNumber.description: The sail number written down, for a boat not named by `competitorId`.

finishTime.description: The time of day the boat finished.

elapsedSecs.description: The boat's elapsed time, for a sheet kept on a stopwatch; instead of `finishTime`.

resultCode.description: For a boat that didn't finish normally.

finishes.description: Row order is crossing order; a row with a `resultCode` takes no place.

complete.description: True once the recording is the whole race.
